description: This file contains functions for parsing numeric and boolean values from strings, with support for units and environment variables, specific to Git project needs.

methods.name: uintmax_t get_unit_factor(const char * end)
methods.description: Determines the numeric multiplier based on unit suffix ('k', 'm', 'g') in input strings.

methods.name: int git_parse_signed(const char * value,intmax_t * ret,intmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses a signed integer with optional unit suffix, validating against a maximum limit.

methods.name: int git_parse_unsigned(const char * value,uintmax_t * ret,uintmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses an unsigned integer with optional unit suffix, validating against a maximum limit.

methods.name: int git_parse_int(const char * value,int * ret)
methods.description: Parses an integer value from string, returning success or failure.

methods.name: int git_parse_int64(const char * value,int64_t * ret)
methods.description: Parses a 64-bit integer value from string.

methods.name: int git_parse_ulong(const char * value,unsigned long * ret)
methods.description: Parses an unsigned long value from string.

methods.name: int git_parse_ssize_t(const char * value,ssize_t * ret)
methods.description: Parses a ssize_t value from string.

methods.name: int git_parse_double(const char * value,double * ret)
methods.description: Parses a double value from string, with optional unit suffix.

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool_text(const char * value)
methods.description: Converts textual boolean representations ('true', 'false', etc.) to integer flags.

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool(const char * value)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a value as boolean, integer, or text, returning an indicator.

methods.name: int git_env_bool(const char * k,int def)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable as a boolean value, defaulting if unset.

methods.name: unsigned long git_env_ulong(const char * k,unsigned long val)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable as an unsigned long with optional unit, defaulting if unset.

ctags.name: git_env_ulong
ctags.pattern: /^unsigned long git_env_ulong(const char *k, unsigned long val)$/
